entities.name: Aesrias
entities.description: A strong Akroan warrior blessed by Iroas who prefers to fight with his fists, narrating how he is framed and sent to the arena.

entities.name: Pilun
entities.description: The corrupt governor of Tynthal who wears a crown, frames Aesrias and has seceded from the true king.

entities.name: Nyxborn Prisoner
entities.description: A star-skinned nyxborn agent of Iroas, caged beside Aesrias, who knew Aesrias's mother and grants him a blessing.

entities.name: Aesrias's mother
entities.description: A warrior who fell at the third battle of the Pharagax Bridge after slaying seven, whose sacrifice led Iroas to bless Aesrias.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of Victory who blesses devout families' children with strength to protect people; Aesrias's patron.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A new god of whom people whisper, whom Aesrias begins adding to his prayers.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: The king of Akros, the only one entitled to wear a crown there.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: The polis that is Aesrias's home and whose king is Anax.

entities.name: Tynthal
entities.description: A large city north of One-Eyed Pass, governed by Pilun, with a detachment of Stratians.

entities.name: The Kolophon
entities.description: The walled capital where the king is, to which Aesrias intends to travel.

entities.name: One-Eyed Pass
entities.description: A pass south of the city of Tynthal.

entities.name: Pharagax Bridge
entities.description: Site of a third battle where Aesrias's mother fell.

entities.name: Stratians
entities.description: Warriors of the Akroan army, a detachment of which is stationed at Tynthal.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Star-skinned agents of the gods walking among mortals, growing in number monthly.

entities.name: Iroan Games
entities.description: Games meant to bring the nations together in competition and to replace illegal arena killing.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the story is set.

events.summary: Aesrias recalls killing a stuporous giant, a hydra, and a flock of harpies, taking the harpy heads to Tynthal.
events.quote: In the end, I killed them all, of course.

events.summary: Aesrias delivers the harpy heads to Governor Pilun in the civic temple, who is crowned and flanked by soldiers.
events.quote: I gave the harpy heads to a young attendant

events.summary: Pilun accuses Aesrias of stealing from a merchant, and a man in rags falsely testifies; Pilun orders the guards to seize him.
events.quote: Guards, it seems we have our criminal.

events.summary: Aesrias, tired and suspecting a plot, lets himself be shackled without a fight.
events.quote: I let them shackle me and did not fight.

events.summary: Aesrias is taken to a coliseum holding pen and realizes he is meant for illegal arena killing.
events.quote: I would be sent to kill or die in an arena.

events.summary: Aesrias meets the star-skinned nyxborn in the next cell, who knew his mother.
events.quote: I've heard your name and I know your mother.

events.summary: The nyxborn explains that it was sent to serve the governor but that Pilun no longer serves the true king, and it cannot free itself.
events.quote: this governor seems to no longer serve the true king.

events.summary: The nyxborn blesses Aesrias with Iroas's power, healing him and strengthening him before he faces sirens; Aesrias asks for candle wax for his ears.
events.quote: He touched my shoulders. And I felt better. My wounds healed. I was no longer tired.

events.summary: Aesrias is led into the coliseum, where Pilun and a few spectators watch as nine chained sirens are released.
events.quote: They all counted together, then released the sirens and ran to the arena's edge.

events.summary: Wax-deafened to their songs and protected by the blessing, Aesrias kills several sirens using their own chains.
events.quote: When the first siren tried to fly away in a panic, she choked her sister to death.

events.summary: Aesrias breaks the chain loop and is carried out of the coliseum and into the countryside by the remaining four sirens.
events.quote: I was able to easily break the links and held fast to the sirens.

events.summary: When the sirens tire and drop, Aesrias kills them; the nyxborn's blessing fades and he resolves to inform the king of Pilun's secession.
events.quote: The journey to the Kolophon to inform the king of Pilun's secession and my encounter with a nyxborn will be dangerous.

relations.quote: Tynthal's governor, Pilun, had summoned me to deal with the harpies.

relations.note: Pilun frames Aesrias and sends him to die in the arena.
relations.quote: Guards, it seems we have our criminal.
I am one of many who are blessed with the might of Iroas

relations.note: The nyxborn says both it and Aesrias serve Iroas.
relations.quote: You and I both serve Iroas.

relations.note: The nyxborn blesses Aesrias and asks no reward.
relations.quote: But it is my gift and I ask no reward.

relations.note: Aesrias's mother, whose sacrifice earned him Iroas's blessing.
relations.quote: her sacrifice was the reason Iroad blessed me.
Governor, I am Aesrias of Akros, Hero of Iroas.
